publication issues.summary: Partial, unapproved: 23 unresolved render differences including 14 wiring glyphs, and 3 converter uncertainties. Team9 viewed the native top output crop and reported a diamond on the +LM REG BIT line with an elbow to the first reference; this does not establish electrical semantics. Other discrepancies were not individually examined. All 50 wire paths, 38 nets, 9 junctions and 83 unjoined crossing records remain unverified. Independent registration and scan warp, continuous traces, systematic omission search and external schema are not established. Raw restoration is derived, not independent acquisition.
